newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends flat in choppy trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends flat in choppy trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended flat on Tuesday from this morning's open at C$1.3865 (US$0.7212) in choppy trading. * Traders said the currency continued to feel pressure from declining interest rates in Canada and speculation that the Bank of Canada would not follow a possible rise in U.S. rates next month.
Analysts said it was surprising that the same factors that led investors to accept lower risk premiums for Canadian investments failed to lift the fortunes of the struggling Canadian dollar.

But the stronger fiscal picture for Canada meant the currency had some staunch support around C$1.3895 (US$0.7196), which allowed it to fight off attempts to push the unit past C$1.3900 (US$0.7194) overnight.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar fell to 80.87 yen from Monday's 81.25 but rose to 1.2383 marks from Monday's 1.2292 marks.
